input.value: mock ValidationContext where resolveSchemaId(schemaNode) returns null

cases.description: When the ValidationContext returns null and a non‑null schemaRetrievalUri is supplied, the method should fall back to the string representation of schemaRetrievalUri.

cases.description: When both the resolved schema ID and the supplied schemaRetrievalUri are null, the method should return the constant SchemaLocation.DOCUMENT.
Even if a schemaRetrievalUri is provided, a non‑null ID resolved from the ValidationContext takes precedence.

input.value: mock ValidationContext where resolveSchemaId(null) returns null

cases.description: Both `schemaNode` and `validationContext` return null, and no fallback URI is supplied – the method should return the constant `SchemaLocation.DOCUMENT`.

cases.description: The ValidationContext resolves an empty string (which is not `null`). The method should treat it as a valid ID and return `SchemaLocation.of("")`, ignoring the null `schemaRetrievalUri`.

input.value: mock ValidationContext where resolveSchemaId(schemaNode) returns null

cases.description: When the ValidationContext returns `null` and the supplied `schemaRetrievalUri` represents an empty string, the method should fall back to that empty string location.

cases.description: Even when a non‑null fallback URI is provided, a resolved empty string from the ValidationContext takes precedence, resulting in `SchemaLocation.of("")`.
Passing a `null` ValidationContext should cause a `NullPointerException` because the method dereferences it to call `resolveSchemaId`.

input.value: mock ValidationContext where resolveSchemaId(schemaNode) throws IllegalStateException

cases.description: When the ValidationContext throws an exception while resolving the schema ID, the exception should propagate out of getSchemaLocation.
A malformed URI string returned from ValidationContext should cause SchemaLocation.of to throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.description: When ValidationContext returns null and the fallback schemaRetrievalUri contains an invalid URI string, SchemaLocation.of should throw IllegalArgumentException.
